phase_name: Newport Origin Village Immersion & City-Planning Gate
human_screenshot_failure_summary: The OVI-1/G-19R technically validating Newport view still read like isolated building sprites on a flat test plane, with giant translucent road and region rectangles, weak parcel logic, empty negative space, and a first impression that did not feel like a real origin harbor town.

forensic_diagnosis.why_current_screen_reads_artificial: The current view gives most of the screen to broad semi-transparent road and ground surfaces, so buildings read as sprites placed on top rather than structures belonging to lots, streets, blocks, thresholds, and work areas.
forensic_diagnosis.giant_slab_flat_plane_source: MapLayer._draw_g19s_source_truth_street_plan rendered G-19R measured corridors through very large _draw_newport_commercial_street Rect2 calls, and the legacy G-7A foundation added broad rectangular terrace washes underneath.
forensic_diagnosis.rectangle_classification: These rectangles were intentional road and ground surfaces, not debug overlays, camera artifacts, or hidden editor guides.
forensic_diagnosis.building_integration_failure: The building anchors were source-driven, but the visual layer did not carry enough parcel edges, frontages, stoops, service lanes, wharf work surfaces, or purposeful prop clusters to make those anchors read as a town plan.
forensic_diagnosis.design_rule_fix: OVI-2 keeps the measured walkable layout but renders it as segmented harborfront avenue pieces, a civic counting-house terrace, rear service lanes, wharf aprons, street curbs, parcel thresholds, and purpose-bound atelier props.

harborfront_commercial_avenue.role: Primary first-screen avenue parallel to the harbor.
harborfront_commercial_avenue.runtime_rule: Use segmented cobble and dirt-wear polygons with curbs and frontages; never one large translucent street rectangle.

civic_counting_house_district.role: Official first-objective anchor with notice boards, flags, posting poles, and a road climbing from harborfront to civic frontage.
civic_counting_house_district.runtime_rule: Civic surfaces must connect to the main avenue and wharf route; the counting house may not float behind unrelated pavement.

tavern_inn_district.role: Memorable west-side social hub and rumor anchor.
tavern_inn_district.runtime_rule: Tavern frontage needs warm entry lighting, threshold planters, brick stoop, service edge, and rear lane context.

shopfront_commercial_street.role: Market and shop row showing the town economy from street frontage to wharf goods.
shopfront_commercial_street.runtime_rule: Signs, awnings, carts, crates, and lamps align to frontages and keep the movement lane open.

wharf_dock_service_edge.role: Working harbor identity with cargo, rope, bollards, fish baskets, net drying, dock rules, lanterns, and plank transitions.
wharf_dock_service_edge.runtime_rule: Wharf goods sit on aprons and piers, not random open pavement.

secondary_lanes.role: Back street and service cuts that make the town feel built, inhabited, and explorable.
secondary_lanes.runtime_rule: Service lanes connect tavern backs, shop backs, civic routes, and the east exit without drawing under building bodies.

player_spawn_origin_area.role: The first impression must say harbor town before the UI says objective.
player_spawn_origin_area.runtime_rule: Spawn view includes waterline/wharf identity, route markers, lanterns, cargo, and a readable path into town.

measurable_design_rules: No oversized translucent road/region rectangles dominating the play area
NPCs placed only on believable walkable/station surfaces

runtime_rendering_requirements.guardrail: Automated validators do not claim full art approval, but they must fail the obvious slab, empty-plane, missing-frontage, and missing-screenshot failures visible in the baseline.

screenshot_package.review_purpose: Player spawn first impression with HUD.
Player spawn first impression with HUD hidden.
Tavern/Inn as a memorable integrated anchor.
Wide town composition and negative-space control.
Movement route proof through authored town lanes.
Current branch composition captured against the baseline failure reference.

known_limits_of_automation: The validator can detect structural visual failures, missing screenshots, and forbidden slab tokens.
The validator cannot fully score beauty, mood, player desire to explore, or all art-direction taste calls.
Agent Council screenshot inspection remains required for the final OVI-2 verdict.
